text: The Fed just hiked rates to 3.75–4% while September payrolls came in at only 29,000 jobs — that's a central bank tightening into a sharply slowing labor market, which raises the risk of a policy mistake that tips the economy into recession.

NCLP.L is your third-largest holding but it's down 26% and 38% below its high with bearish momentum — trim this position to reduce its outsized drag on your portfolio, especially with the jobs market weakening.

IonQ is down 11% with a relative strength of negative 47, insider selling, and no profitability — reduce your exposure here before this money-losing position deteriorates further in a rising-rate environment.
Raise your MSTR stop from $113.23 to $118.94 to lock in more of your 10% gain, since this leveraged Bitcoin bet is still 56% below its high and you want to protect profits if it rolls over.
Microsoft is showing a bullish MACD with price above its 50-day average — it's the strongest big tech name in your portfolio and worth adding to on this setup.
Visa is one of the most durable businesses you own, and a 5% pullback to its 50-day average in a company with consistent cash flow is a chance to add shares at a fair price.
